comments.body:
Quest name: "World of Possibilities"

10 stars, London Adventurers' Guild 428,000/40,000 ducats
Search r9 Appraisal r11 Greek Language

-Speak to the Seville Port Official
-Speak to Tradescant in front of the Acropolis of Atlantis Port Official
-Speak to the Young Boy just south of the Acropolis of Atlantis Port Offical
-Speak to Julien, due east from the Acropolis of Atlantis Port Official
-Speak to the Frankfurt Charioteer
-Speak to Tradescant near the Hamburg Port Official
-Search next to the Hamburg Port Official

Reward: 930/465 exp, 1 Doctoral Thesis on Navigation (+10,000 oxford credits) and a Cameo Habille (Accessory, Durability 50, Formality 40, Sociability +2, Repair +1, Increase Skill Effect Duration)

This is the last quest in the Atlantis Adventure chain

comments.author: RvZ
comments.body:
Quest name: World of Possibilities (Chrono Quest - Mythical Era)
Quest location: London Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r9 Search, r11 Appraisal, GRE(Greek)
Pre-requisite discovery: Truth of Atlantis (from "The Qualifications and Resolve to Know" quest) + Acropolis of Atlantis
Pre-requisite action (hidden): Atlantis must be available for visit
Additional notes: Last quest of Atlantis adventure route questchain
